==Sets of clothing==
The Tailor accepts specific animal materials to create sets of clothing. You can order sets of wool, cotton, silk or rare silk clothing. This costs 4 units of cloth and creates 2 shoes, 1 shirt and 1 trouser.

==Sets of armor==
You can make armor sets from leather, tough leather, studded leather, lameller leather, chitin plate, rigid chitinplate, shellplate, rigid shellplate, scaleplate and rigid scaleplate. This costs 5 units of leather and gives you 2 boots, 1 trouser, 2 gloves, 1 armor and 1 helm.

==Thread==
You can also take cloth and unravel it into thread, if you need thread for sutures or moods.

==Material strength==
*Leather = Vanilla leather
*Tough leather = [[cv:Copper|Copper]]
*Studded leather = [[cv:Copper|Copper]]
*Lamellar leather = [[cv:Iron|Iron]]
*Chitin/Shell/Scale = Bronze
*Rigid Chitin/Shell/Scale = Iron
